title: Auto-rename config (mpi-auto-rename)
description: Session title generation. Unknown keys and invalid values are ignored at load time.

model.description: `provider/modelId` used for title generation; omit or "inherit" = active session model.

thinking.description: Thinking level for title generation; omit or "inherit" = active session thinking.

onFirstMessage.description: Generate a title when the session's first user message is sent.

maxContextChars.description: Conversation excerpt budget in characters. Default 4000.
